sentences.englishText: This enthusiasm, empathy and joy are shared in the entire of Turkey.
sentences.turkishText: Türkiye'nin 780 bin kilometrekaresinde bu heyecan, bu empati, bu coşku ortak bir şekilde hissedilir.

sentences.englishText: We are proud to belong to a culture that says "We love the created, because of the Creator" and which makes the call "Come, whoever you are, come".
sentences.turkishText: Bizler, "Yaradılanı severiz, yaradandan ötürü" diyen, "Ne olursan ol, gel!" çağrısı yapan bir kültürün çocukları olmakla gurur duyarız.

sentences.englishText: The history and culture of Anatolia has been shaped with such an understanding of tolerance.
sentences.turkishText: Anadolu'nun kültürü ve tarihi böyle bir hoşgörü anlayışıyla yoğrulmuştur.

enrichment.summary: This enthusiasm, empathy and joy are shared in the entire of Turkey. We are proud to belong to a culture that says "We love the created, because of the Creator" and which makes the call "Come, whoever you are, come".
